title: fix(runtime-vapor): write .prop and value bindings during hydration

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Fixed hydration for client-only property bindings, including `.prop` values and `<select>` value bindings, so they are applied to the DOM and stay in sync with state changes.
  * Fixed camelCase ARIA bindings to hydrate correctly against server-rendered attributes and update when their values change.
  * These cases no longer produce hydration mismatch warnings.
